title: Quercetin - Nootropics Expert
abstract:
### **Quercetin reduces inflammation**  
High fat diets cause *oxidative stress* which may lead to *neurodegenerative disease*.  
In one study, a test group of mice were fed high fat diets and given *Quercetin*. The scientists found that *Quercetin reduced the cognitive impairment induced by the high fat diet*.[\[xxiii\]](#_edn23)  
*Quercetin* has been shown to improve neuronal functional recovery in rats affected with *intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH)* by *inhibiting inflammatory response and apoptosis* and *promoting nerve function restoration*.[\[xxiv\]](#_edn24)  
Recent studies show that *Quercetin* reduces the symptoms of Alzheimer’s disease and other [age-related cognitive disorders](https://nootropicsexpert.com/nootropics-glossary/#agerelated-cognitive-decline).[\[xxv\]](#_edn25)
## **Quercetin Recommended Dosage**  
The recommended [nootropic](https://nootropicsexpert.com/nootropics-glossary/#nootropic) dosage for *Quercetin* is 500 mg up to twice per day.  
*Quercetin* dosages of 1,000 mg, and on the advice of your doctor, up to 3,000 mg per day to *reduce COVID-19 symptoms*. *Note that this is short-term use only at such elevated dosages*.  
Your daily intake of *Quercetin* from food in a typical Western diet is estimated to range between 0 – 30 mg per day.  
*Quercetin as a supplement has low [bioavailability](https://nootropicsexpert.com/nootropics-glossary/#bioavailability)* because it does not easily cross the intestinal wall.[\[xxviii\]](#_edn28)  
Poor bioavailability is why many *Quercetin* supplements include other compounds like [Vitamin C](https://nootropicsexpert.com/13-vitamins-essential-for-the-optimized-brain/#vitamin-c), bromelain, or other *digestive enzymes* to help boost absorption.  
A more recent development shows increased absorption of *Quercetin* when attached to a [phospholipid](https://nootropicsexpert.com/nootropics-glossary/#phospholipids) complex made from lecithin called *Phytosome®*.  
*Quercetin Phytosome®* has been shown to be *20-times more bioavailable* than *Quercetin* on its own.[\[xxix\]](#_edn29)
## **Type of Quercetin to Buy**  
*Quercetin* as a [nootropic](https://nootropicsexpert.com/nootropics-glossary/#nootropic) is available in capsules and bags of powder.  
You’ll see several brands offering *Quercetin + Bromelain* because adding a digestive enzyme helps its *bioavailability*.  
And the latest is *Quercetin Phytosome*® which is *Quercetin* combined with *lecithin-derived [phospholipids](https://nootropicsexpert.com/nootropics-glossary/#phospholipids)* from sunflower to *cross the gut barrier more easily*.
